name: multi-value-visa-extraction
description: P0 baseline probe: multi-value array fields + visa scalar in one turn. Tests the scalar→array coercion (#245) on real multi-value output AND whether the model captures visa + multiple locations + multiple industries together.

turns.inbound: I need H1B sponsorship. Open to NYC or remote. Interested in fintech or AI infra. Full-time only.

expect.grade_criteria: The candidate stated: needs H1B sponsorship (visaStatus=sponsor_needed), locations NYC + remote, industries fintech + AI/infra, full-time. PASS if visaStatus=sponsor_needed AND targetLocations captures both NYC and remote AND targetJobType=full_time AND industrySector reflects fintech and AI/infra. Partial-credit note in reasoning if some axes are captured but not all — flag which axes the extractor dropped (this is baseline signal for prompt tuning).
